summary: Manage reversible object attribute overlays with activations that can be started, stopped, and queried.

traps.quote: resolve its path after all preceding replacements in that same activation have been applied
traps.consequence: Using stale values when paths depend on other replacements in activation
traps.guard: Resolve each path immediately before applying replacement, seeing current state

traps.quote: read and follow the object reference in every attribute except the last
traps.consequence: Following final attribute as reference instead of reading it as target cell
traps.guard: Follow L-1 attributes to reach target object, then read cell at attribute L

traps.quote: restore that activation's remembered writes in reverse replacement order
traps.consequence: Restored values applied in wrong order, overwriting each other incorrectly
traps.guard: When restoring, iterate replacements in reverse order

traps.quote: STOPALL stops all active activations from newest to oldest
traps.consequence: Restored values overwritten by subsequent restorations in wrong order
traps.guard: Stop activations in reverse order (newest/most-recent first)

traps.quote: number of active activations followed by their IDs from oldest to newest on one line
traps.consequence: Wrong output format or ID order, failing test cases
traps.guard: Print count and IDs on same line, IDs in activation order (oldest first)

traps.quote: Remembered paths are never resolved again
traps.consequence: Re-resolving paths gets different cells after other activations change values
traps.guard: Store resolved cell reference when remembering, restore to that cell

input_shape: N,K,Q bounds; K cells with object/attribute/kind/value; Q commands (START, STOP, STOPALL, GET, STACK)
output_shape: GET outputs (I x or O x); STACK outputs (count and activation IDs on one line)
invariants: Replacements in activation see effects of preceding replacements in same activation
Restoration must happen in reverse of replacement order within activation
STOPALL processes activations from newest to oldest, not oldest to newest
max_scale: N,K,Q ≤ 200k; total replacements ≤ 200k; sum path lengths ≤ 400k
